text:
incident-bot: ALERT: sudden spike in token requests from org=apollo, error rate up (503s), RL throttles firing. paging oncall. :rotating_light:
oncall-maya: looking now. thanks. pinging @eng-tom and @ops-ryan for live mitigation.
eng-tom: pulling recent qps heatmap. seeing a ~6x baseline jump, concentrated on /v1/generate.
ops-ryan: confirmed many RL hit logs: `org=apollo limit=default qps=120 -> 429` and backend 503s when cache pressure climbs.
liz-sales: heads up — Apollo is a paid partner, CS notified, they're seeing customer complaints. I'll stand by to help comms.
oncall-maya: priority here is customer-facing availability. propose temporary tuned limit increase + traffic shaping to smooth burst.
eng-tom: recommend surgical bump: add per-org override policy at edge: `policy(apollo): qps=600, burst=1200, ttl=15m, grace=10%` apply to route /v1/generate only. will monitor.
sre-bot: METRICS: 95th latency on /v1/generate = 2.8s, errors 13% (last 5m).
ops-ryan: I'll stage the rule in the canary pool (5% of Apollo flows) first. command: ```ri-admin policy apply --org apollo --route /v1/generate --qps 600 --burst 1200 --ttl 15m --canary=5%```
eng-tom: doing canary now. will watch p50/p95 and backend CPU.
(30s later)
eng-tom: canary looks good: no backend tail latency, errors down from 13% -> 4% for canary shard.
oncall-maya: proceed to roll to 25% then 100% in increments if metrics stay healthy. keep TTL so it auto-reverts.
ops-ryan: rolling to 25%... 25% ok, rolling to 100%...
(2m later)
ops-ryan: 100% rolled. overall errors down to 2.1%, tail latency stable.
liz-sales: telling Apollo support team we've applied a temporary safety bump; will follow up with postmortem and timeline. they appreciate the quick action.
ben: taking secondary oncall watch. if anything changes ping me, I'll cover while Maya heads to other pager.
oncall-maya: handing off to @ben. summary: applied 15m temporary per-org override for /v1/generate (qps600 burst1200), canary verified. watch error rate and token burn. will coordinate with product for permanent adjustment.
eng-tom: note: this bump increases per-token spend. recommend follow-up: evaluate request fanout and aggregation (prompt batching) with Apollo before making permanent.
ops-ryan: creating short-lived incident ticket and tagging billing/controls so we can mark this as emergency adjustment. ticket: INC-3955554321.
sre-bot: ALERT: memory pressure on allocation pool rose 8% during bump but remained under safety threshold. no action needed.
eng-tom: planning rollback: auto-ttl 15m; manual rollback if error rate <1% stable for 10m or if backend CPU > 80%.
ben: noted. I'll keep watch, escalate if metrics regress.
liz-sales: will schedule a customer sync within the hour and ask Apollo to throttle noisy clients if possible.
oncall-maya: closing live thread for now but keep channel open. add any follow-ups to INC-3955554321. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident update recorded: emergency rate-limit override applied for org=apollo, policy_id=erg-3955, expires in 15m.
